title: Finite-type approximation models and the base colimit
statement: Let φ : R → S be a finitely presented homomorphism of commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. There exist a small nonempty directed preorder Λ, functors Rfun,Sfun : Λ → CommRing, a natural transformation η : Rfun → Sfun, and cocones cR,cS with points R,S. Their legs satisfy κ_l η_l = φ π_l. Each η_l is finite type, and each R_l is finite type over ℤ [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra]. Every transition square and every square with the final map φ is a pushout. The base cocone cR is a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. No colimit property for cS is asserted.

proof.text: Apply the proved finite-presentation descent theorem CommRingCat.exists_isPushout_of_finitePresentation realizing [lem-kun-fp-algebra-descent] to the full finite-type integer subalgebra diagram and its colimit [lemma-nagata-ring-finite-type-subalgebras]. Obtain one index j, a finitely presented map g:R_j→T and a pushout square with φ. This source declaration is sorry-free; the chosen witnesses occur only in the existential theorem proof, not in a public definition.

Index by the finitely generated integer subalgebras containing R_j. The index is inhabited by R_j; the supremum of two members is finitely generated and is an upper bound. For each x∈R, the supremum of R_j and the subalgebra generated by x contains x, so the supremum of the family is top. Apply CommRingCat.isColimitSubalgebraCocone, the general subalgebra-colimit construction in [lemma-nagata-ring-finite-type-subalgebras], to prove the restricted base cocone is colimiting.

For each member A define S_A to be the categorical pushout of R_j→A and g:R_j→T. Define transition maps and maps to S using pushout.desc. Check identity, composition, cocone compatibility and naturality by pushout.hom_ext and the two pushout.inl_desc/inr_desc equations. The base inclusions compose strictly, giving ha and hac in Lean. This constructs all data explicitly from the chosen finite-stage model.

Finite presentation of g implies finite type. RingHom.finiteType_isStableUnderBaseChange.pushout_inl proves every A→S_A is finite type. Subalgebra.fg_iff_finiteType and RingHom.finiteType_algebraMap prove each A is finite type over the integers. These are proved Mathlib tools; no additional approximation statement is used.

For A⊆B, compare the pushout defining S_A with the pushout defining S_B. IsPushout.of_left, flipped, proves the transition square is a pushout after rewriting ha and the inr_desc equation. For the final square, flip the original descended pushout, rewrite its base leg using hac, and apply IsPushout.of_top to cancel the pushout defining S_A; the cocone desc equations give the needed commutativity. Since the cocone points are definitionally R,S, all transports eqToHom along the supplied point equalities simplify to identities.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_limit_finite_presentation_core
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (φ : R →+* S)
    (hφ : RingHom.FinitePresentation φ) :
    ∃ (Λ : Type u) (_hpo : Preorder Λ) (_hne : Nonempty Λ)
      (_hdir : IsDirected Λ (fun a b => a ≤ b))
      (Rfun : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat) (Sfun : Λ ⥤ CommRingCat)
      (η : Rfun ⟶ Sfun) (cR : Cocone Rfun) (cS : Cocone Sfun),
      cR.pt = CommRingCat.of R ∧ cS.pt = CommRingCat.of S ∧
      (∀ l (hR : cR.pt = CommRingCat.of R) (hS : cS.pt = CommRingCat.of S),
        η.app l ≫ cS.ι.app l = cR.ι.app l ≫
          (eqToHom hR ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ ≫ eqToHom hS.symm)) ∧
      (∀ l, RingHom.FiniteType (η.app l).hom) ∧
      (∀ l, RingHom.FiniteType (algebraMap ℤ (Rfun.obj l))) ∧
      (∀ l m (h : l ≤ m),
        Nonempty (CategoryTheory.IsPushout (η.app l) (Rfun.map (homOfLE h))
          (Sfun.map (homOfLE h)) (η.app m))) ∧
      (∀ l (hR : cR.pt = CommRingCat.of R) (hS : cS.pt = CommRingCat.of S),
        Nonempty (CategoryTheory.IsPushout (η.app l) (cR.ι.app l) (cS.ι.app l)
          (eqToHom hR ≫ CommRingCat.ofHom φ ≫ eqToHom hS.symm))) ∧
      Nonempty (IsColimit cR)
